sentences.text: By virtue of the present petition,

the petitioner seeks the following reliefs:
"I. Quash the impugned Notice Dated 27.01.2025, U/s 84 of the BNSS 2023, Issued by the Ld. CJM, South-West Dwarka, in the FIR bearing no. 80/2024, U/s 420,
466,468, 471, 120B, 34 IPC registered at PS Cyber Police Station South-West District,
Dwarka in the interest of justice, AND/OR;.
II. Pass Practice Directions to be followed by the Delhi Police further clarifying the position of law regarding the procedure to issue the Notice U/S 35(3) of B.N.S.S.,2023 with respect to use of an Official Seal, Serial No. Date of Issuance etc.
AND/OR; III. Pass Practice directions, for clarifying the position of law regarding presence of the Accused through Video Conferencing, more This is a digitally signed order.

PS Cyber Police Station South-West District,
Dwarka

sentences.text: IV. Such other or further Order(s) as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper, in the facts and circumstances of the present case, be also passed in favour of the petitioner, to meet the ends of justice."
4. At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he does not wish to press the prayer clauses II and III.
5. Accordingly, the said reliefs are dropped and shall not be considered at the time of adjudication of the present petition by this Court.
7. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
She seeks, and is granted four weeks for filing the Status Report alongwith SCRB Report.

8. It is clarified that though the learned Trial Court shall proceed with the proceedings before it on 17.03.2025 as also on all subsequent dates, however, the learned Trial Court shall be restrained from passing any final order therein prior to the next date of hearing.

9. Renotify on 15.05.2025.
SAURABH BANERJEE, J MARCH 12, 2025/Ab
